_meta.notes: Seeded during the upstream-sources-registry build by migrating plugin-rulebook's former 'Tracked Upstream Sources' table and settings.json _meta.review_triggers. Two of that table's six rows (skill-development/references/size-limits.md, skill-reviewer C1/C2 severity tier logic) were internal plugin-devkit files, not official sources -- they were miscategorized in the old table and are intentionally NOT migrated here; see references/migration-notes.md. Seed entries below have not yet had a live freshness check run against them -- last_verified/last_verified_snapshot are null until the first real check populates them; do not treat a null last_verified as a fabricated or assumed check.

sources.name: Claude Code skill/agent frontmatter field spec
sources.last_verified_snapshot: URL migrated: docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/skills now 301-redirects here. Frontmatter reference table: all fields optional (only 'description' recommended); full field list is name, description, when_to_use, argument-hint, arguments, disable-model-invocation, user-invocable, allowed-tools, disallowed-tools, model, effort, context, agent, background, hooks, paths, shell. Notably: 'allowed-tools' pre-approves tools for the invoking turn only (clears on next message) and does NOT restrict which tools are callable -- 'every tool remains callable, and your permission settings still govern tools that are not listed.'

Page does not enumerate a comprehensive valid-tool-name list or explicit 'forbidden pattern' rules beyond the wildcard examples shown.

sources.name: Claude Code plugin.json manifest schema
sources.last_verified_snapshot: 'name' is the only required field. Metadata fields: $schema (ignored at load), displayName (v2.1.143+), version (optional semver; plugin.json wins over marketplace entry if both set), description, author (object), homepage (string), repository (string), license (string), keywords (array), defaultEnabled (boolean, v2.1.154+, default true; marketplace entry's value takes precedence over plugin.json's here -- opposite precedence direction from version). Component path fields: skills, commands, agents, hooks, mcpServers, outputStyles, lspServers, experimental.themes, experimental.monitors, userConfig (object), channels (array), dependencies (array). Unrecognized top-level fields are ignored at load and reported as warnings (not errors) by `claude plugin validate`; wrong-typed fields (e.g. keywords as a string instead of an array) are load errors. `--strict` promotes warnings to errors. Top-level (non-experimental.*) themes/monitors still work today but validate already warns; a future release requires the experimental.* form.
